randomness: torchcrepe adds NumPy/SciPy pitch dither. Fix Python/NumPy/Torch seeds and share verified pitch contours between decoder comparisons. GPU/library changes may still affect floating point rounding.
purpose: Small reproducible engineering regression; not a public dataset leaderboard
remaining_cases: Regression confirmation only; not a statistically independent hidden test set

lyrics.normalization: NFKC, casefold, punctuation removed, apostrophes collapsed; no traditional/simplified conversion

timing.alignment: monotonic Levenshtein exact token matches; no forced token splitting

notes.aggregation: macro per language; same singer clips form one bootstrap cluster

beats.training_overlap: Beat This final/small trained on GuitarSet: diagnostic only; fair comparisons require matching published out-of-fold checkpoint

chords.aggregation: macro per clip; do not compare scores with different eligible duration

separation.alignment: same decoded sample count, rate, stereo flattened; no fitted time shift
separation.scope: two ~6.8s AAC previews, not full-song BSS Eval SDR

runtime.memory_scope: device-wide nvidia-smi includes display and other processes; allocator peak excludes CTranslate2

required: all selected cases accounted for including failures
same paired case IDs and references
no automatic silent retry hiding a crash
promotion.quality_rule: report paired per-case deltas and grouped bootstrap intervals; choose changes by task, never one mixed accuracy score
promotion.regression_rule: list every >0.05 absolute primary-score regression; preserve an explicit baseline option
promotion.limited_evidence: Only 7 English mixes, 4 GTS singers, 5 guitar clips and 2 stems: improvements are provisional

product: active analysis delete rejection and cancellation
lyric correction, stale revision rejection, reset and persistence
